import re

with open('/tmp/schedule.txt', 'r') as f:
    text = f.read()
lines = text.split('\n')

# Find all page boundaries
page_lines = []
for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
    m = re.search(r'第\s+(\d+)\s+页', line)
    if m:
        page_lines.append((idx, int(m.group(1))))

# Define section ranges from line numbers
# 思政B: line 4017 onwards
# 七大模块: multiple ranges starting at 4430, 4831, 5291, etc.
# 软件体系结构: around 72725
# 自然语言处理: around 73280, 73816

# Let's first extract all course entries from the pdftotext output
# A course entry typically starts with a Course ID like COMP130025.01
# Pattern: course ID like CHIN119001.01, COMP130025.01, etc.

def parse_courses():
    courses = []
    section = None
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i].strip()
        
        # Check for section headers
        if '通识教育核心课程——思想政治理论课程B组' in line:
            section = '思政B'
            i += 1
            continue
        elif '通识教育核心课程——七大模块课程' in line:
            section = '七大模块'
            i += 1
            continue
        elif '通识教育核心课程——公共艺术课程' in line:
            section = '公共艺术'
            i += 1
            continue
        
        # Check for module line (just a module name on a line)
        if line in ('模块', '选修/必修'):
            i += 1
            continue
        
        # Check for course ID pattern
        # Course IDs look like: CHIN119001.01, COMP130025.01, PEDU110134.01, PTSS110082.01
        if re.match(r'^[A-Z]{2,4}\d{5,6}\.\d+$', line):
            course = {'id': line, 'section': section}
            # Try to parse the next several lines as fields
            j = i + 1
            fields = {}
            
            # Skip empty lines between section header and first course
            while j < len(lines) and not lines[j].strip() and not re.match(r'^[A-Z]{2,4}\d{5,6}\.\d+$', lines[j+1] if j+1 < len(lines) else ''):
                j += 1
            
            if j < len(lines):
                # Module (sometimes on same line or next)
                # Course name (can be multiline)
                course_name = ''
                while j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip() and not re.match(r'^\d+\.?\d*$', lines[j].strip()) and \
                      not re.match(r'^\s*[一二三四五六日]', lines[j].strip()) and \
                      not re.match(r'^[A-Z]{2,4}\d{5,6}\.\d+$', lines[j].strip()) and \
                      not re.match(r'^考试', lines[j].strip()) and \
                      not re.match(r'^第\s', lines[j].strip()):
                    if course_name:
                        course_name += lines[j].strip()
                    else:
                        course_name = lines[j].strip()
                    j += 1
                if course_name:
                    course['name'] = course_name
                
                # Credits (a number like 2, 3, 4.5)
                if j < len(lines) and re.match(r'^\d+\.?\d*$', lines[j].strip()):
                    course['credits'] = lines[j].strip()
                    j += 1
                
                # Instructor name
                if j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip():
                    course['instructor'] = lines[j].strip()
                    j += 1
                
                # Title (职称) - check if it's a title like 教授, 副教授, etc.
                if j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip() in ('教授', '副教授', '讲师', '助理研究员', '青年副研究员', '副研究员', '研究员'):
                    course['title'] = lines[j].strip()
                    j += 1
                
                # Time (like 一 4-5 [1-16])
                time_pattern = re.match(r'^[一二三四五六日]\s+\d+-\d+\s+\[.*?\]', lines[j].strip())
                if time_pattern:
                    course['time'] = lines[j].strip()
                    j += 1
                
                # Classroom
                if j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip() in ('邯郸校区', '江湾校区', '枫林校区'):
                    course['campus'] = lines[j].strip()
                    j += 1
                
                # Enrollment (number)
                if j < len(lines) and re.match(r'^\d+$', lines[j].strip()):
                    course['enrollment'] = lines[j].strip()
                    j += 1
                
                # Notes (备注) - can be multiline
                notes = ''
                while j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip() and not re.match(r'^考试', lines[j].strip()) and \
                      not re.match(r'^[A-Z]{2,4}\d{5,6}\.\d+$', lines[j].strip()) and \
                      not re.match(r'^含A\+$', lines[j].strip()):
                    if notes:
                        notes += lines[j].strip() + ' '
                    else:
                        notes = lines[j].strip()
                    j += 1
                if notes.strip():
                    course['notes'] = notes.strip()
                
                # Exam date and time
                while j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip():
                    if '考试日期' in lines[j]:
                        course['exam_date'] = lines[j].strip().replace('考试日期:', '').strip()
                    elif '考试时间' in lines[j]:
                        exam_time_val = lines[j].strip().replace('考试时间:', '').strip()
                        if not course.get('exam_time'):
                            course['exam_time'] = exam_time_val
                        else:
                            course['exam_time'] += ' | ' + exam_time_val
                    j += 1
                
                # Assessment method
                if j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip() in ('开卷', '闭卷', '论文', '口试', '其他'):
                    course['assessment'] = lines[j].strip()
                    j += 1
                
                # 含A+
                if j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip() == '是':
                    course['has_a_plus'] = True
                    j += 1
                
                # Department
                while j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip():
                    if j < len(lines) and re.match(r'^[A-Z]{2,4}\d{5,6}\.\d+$', lines[j].strip()):
                        break
                    if lines[j].strip():
                        if '院系' not in course:
                            course['department'] = lines[j].strip()
                    j += 1
                
            courses.append(course)
            i = j
        else:
            i += 1
    
    return courses

courses = parse_courses()
print(f'Total courses parsed: {len(courses)}')

# Show courses by section
for sec in ['思政B', '七大模块']:
    sec_courses = [c for c in courses if c.get('section') == sec]

def extract_courses_from_pages(pdf, page_numbers):
    all_entries = []
    
    for page_num in page_numbers:
        page = pdf.pages[page_num - 1]
        lines_data = page.extract_words(x_tolerance=3, y_tolerance=5, group_by_cols=True)
        
        if not lines_data:
            print(f"Page {page_num}: No words extracted")
            continue
        
        # Group words into rows by y-position
        rows = {}
        for word in lines_data:
            y = round(word['top'], 0)
            if y not in rows:
                rows[y] = []
            rows[y].append((word['x0'], word['text']))
        
        # Sort rows by y, then sort each row by x
        sorted_rows = sorted(rows.items(), key=lambda x: x[0])
        
        # Now group into course entries

        # For each row, classify the text based on x-position
        
        col_boundaries = [
            (0, 100, 'id'),      # 选课序号

                    if current_entry.get('id'):

                # Section tags like '思政B'

                # Title keywords
                if text in ('教授', '副教授', '讲师', '助理研究员', '副研究员', '研究员', '青年副研究员'):
                    current_entry['title'] = text
                    continue
                
                # Time pattern: 一 4-5 [1-16] or similar
                if re.match(r'^[一二三四五六日]\s+\d+-\d+\s+\[', text):

                    continue
                
                # Assessment methods
                if text in ('开卷', '闭卷', '论文', '口试', '其他', '论文/报告', '报告'):
                    current_entry['assessment'] = text
                    continue

                    if current_entry.get('notes'):

                    else:

# the data belongs to the PREVIOUS course

# Actually, looking at the data structure:
# After the 思政课B header, data starts with: name, credits+instr, title, time, campus, enrollment, ID
# Then exam info, assessment, department follow
# Then next course's name...

# So for each ID line, the data BEFORE it (name through enrollment) belongs to that course
# And the exam/assessment/dept AFTER the ID belongs to that course too

# But pdftotext output order within a row is: name, credits, title, time, campus, enrollment
# The ID comes at the end of the row (after enrollment)
# Then exam date/time, assessment, dept

# Let me trace each course entry by finding the block between this ID and the next ID
for ci, (idx, cid) in enumerate(course_ids):
    # Find the block for this course: from the line before the previous ID (or start)
    if ci == 0:

    else:

    end_idx = course_ids[ci+1][0] if ci < len(course_ids)-1 else len(lines)
    
    # Collect lines for this course

    name = ''
    credits = ''
    instructor = ''
    title = ''
    times = []
    campus = ''
    enrollment = ''

            credits = parts[0]
            instructor = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ''
            continue
        
        if bl in ('教授', '副教授', '讲师', '助理研究员', '副研究员', '研究员', '青年副研究员'):

            times.append(bl)
            continue

    assessment = ''
    dept = ''
    for bl in block:
        bl = bl.strip()
        if not bl:

        if bl in ('开卷', '闭卷', '论文', '口试', '其他', '随堂考试'):

        if '马克思主义' in bl:

            continue
        if re.match(r'^\d+$', bl):
            continue
    
    time_str = ' '.join(times) if times else ''
    print(f'{cid}: Name={name} Time={time_str} Assess={assessment} Dept={dept}')

all_target_ids = [sa_id, nlp_id, sfb_id] + tgr_ids

# Extract course data from all relevant pages
def extract_all_courses(pdf):
    courses = {}
    target_pages = [30, 251, 252, 254, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37]
    
    for p in target_pages:
        page = pdf.pages[p-1]
        text = page.extract_text() or ''
        lines = text.split('\n')
        
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            # Find all course IDs on this line
            for m in re.finditer(r'([A-Z]{2,4}\d{5,6}\.\d+)', line):
                cid = m.group(1)
                if cid not in all_target_ids:
                    continue
                
                # Get the complete entry
                # The format is: ID Name Credits Instructor Title Time Campus Enrollment Notes ExamDate ExamTime Assessment HasA Dept Restriction
                # All on one line in pdfplumber output
                
                # Start from this line and collect subsequent lines that are exam info
                block_lines = [line]
                j = i + 1
                while j < len(lines) and not re.search(r'[A-Z]{2,4}\d{5,6}\.\d+', lines[j]):
                    # Check if it's exam-related or department
                    if lines[j].strip() and lines[j].strip() not in ('', '考试类型', '考试时间'):
                        if not any(x in lines[j] for x in ['考试日期', '考试时间']) or lines[j].strip().startswith('考试'):
                            block_lines.append(lines[j])
                            j += 1
                            continue
                    if re.search(r'[A-Z]{2,4}\d{5,6}\.\d+', lines[j]):
                        break
                    if lines[j].strip() in ('考试日期:', '考试时间:'):
                        break
                    if re.match(r'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', lines[j].strip()):
                        block_lines.append(lines[j])
                        j += 1
                        continue
                    if '考试' in lines[j]:
                        block_lines.append(lines[j])
                        j += 1
                        continue
                    # Check if it looks like department name
                    if re.match(r'^[\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,10}$', lines[j].strip()):
                        block_lines.append(lines[j])
                        j += 1
                        continue
                    break
                
                full_text = ' '.join(block_lines)
                
                # Parse fields
                entry = parse_course_line(cid, full_text)
                if entry:
                    courses[cid] = entry
    
    return courses

def parse_course_line(cid, text):
    entry = {'id': cid}
    
    # Remove the course ID from the beginning to get remaining text
    remaining = text.replace(cid, '', 1).strip()
    
    # Try to parse: Name Credits Instructor Title Time Campus Enrollment Notes ExamDate ExamTime Assessment HasA Dept
    # The course name is 2-10 Chinese characters
    # Split by spaces
    tokens = remaining.split()
    
    # Course name: Chinese characters (possibly multiple)
    name = ''
    token_idx = 0
    
    # First tokens that are Chinese chars = name
    while token_idx < len(tokens) and re.match(r'^[\u4e00-\u9fa5\u3000\uFF08\uFF09\u300E\u300F\u201C\u201D\u2018\u2019\u2014\u2026]+$', tokens[token_idx]):
        if name:
            name += tokens[token_idx]
        else:
            name = tokens[token_idx]
        token_idx += 1
    
    # Credits: number
    if token_idx < len(tokens) and re.match(r'^\d+\.?\d*$', tokens[token_idx]):
        entry['credits'] = tokens[token_idx]
        token_idx += 1
    
    # Instructor: 2-4 Chinese characters
    if token_idx < len(tokens) and re.match(r'^[\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,4}$', tokens[token_idx]):
        entry['instructor'] = tokens[token_idx]
        token_idx += 1
    
    # Title: 教授/副教授/讲师/etc.
    if token_idx < len(tokens) and tokens[token_idx] in ['教授', '副教授', '讲师', '助理研究员', '副研究员', '研究员', '青年副研究员', '高级工程师', '工程师', '教授\(教学为主型\)']:
        entry['title'] = tokens[token_idx]
        token_idx += 1
    
    # Time: 一 4-5 [1-16]
    if token_idx < len(tokens) and re.match(r'^[一二三四五六日]\s+\d+-\d+\s+\[', tokens[token_idx]):
        entry['time'] = tokens[token_idx]
        token_idx += 1
        # Check for additional time slots
        while token_idx < len(tokens) and re.match(r'^[一二三四五六日]\s+\d+-\d+\s+\[', tokens[token_idx]):
            entry['time'] += ' ' + tokens[token_idx]
            token_idx += 1
    
    # Campus
    if token_idx < len(tokens) and tokens[token_idx] in ['邯郸校区', '江湾校区', '枫林校区', '张江校区']:
        entry['campus'] = tokens[token_idx]
        token_idx += 1
    
    # Enrollment (number)
    if token_idx < len(tokens) and re.match(r'^\d+$', tokens[token_idx]):
        entry['enrollment'] = tokens[token_idx]
        token_idx += 1
    
    # Notes/Remarks (text between enrollment and exam info)
    notes_parts = []
    while token_idx < len(tokens):
        t = tokens[token_idx]
        # Stop at exam-related tokens
        if t in ['考试日期', '闭卷', '开卷', '闭卷', '闭卷'] or re.match(r'^\d{4}-', t):
            break
        if '考试' in t and not t.startswith('考试'):
            break
        # Check if it looks like department
        if re.match(r'^[\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,10}$', t):
            entry['department'] = t
            token_idx += 1
            continue
        notes_parts.append(t)
        token_idx += 1
    
    # Assessment (闭卷/开卷/论文/口试/其他)
    if token_idx < len(tokens) and tokens[token_idx] in ['开卷', '闭卷', '论文', '口试', '其他', '报告']:
        entry['assessment'] = tokens[token_idx]
        token_idx += 1
    
    # Check for A+
    if token_idx < len(tokens) and tokens[token_idx] == '是':
        entry['has_a_plus'] = '是'
        token_idx += 1
    
    # Department might be captured later
    if 'department' not in entry:
        # Look in the full text for department
        dept_match = re.search(r'(计算与智能创新学院|计算机科学技术学院|马克思主义学院|哲学学院|外国语言文学学院|信息科学与工程学院|生命科学学院|中国语言文学系|国际关系与公共事务学院)', text)
        if dept_match:
            entry['department'] = dept_match.group(1)
    
    # Exam time from remaining text
    exam_match = re.search(r'考试时间:\s*([^\n]+)', text)
    if exam_match:
        entry['exam_time'] = exam_match.group(1).strip()
    
    return entry

courses = extract_all_courses(pdf)

print('\nExtracted courses:')
for cid, c in courses.items():
